title: Fluchtpunkt! – Developing a pseudo-3D racing game with AI
author: Clear-Capital-3988
selftext:
I'd like to share a browser game and an article about my experience developing it with AI. 

The game is called **Fluchtpunkt!** and is a pseudo-3D racing game inspired by the classic Lotus Turbo Challenge 2.

The game is largely AI-coded and uses AI-generated assets, including music, alongside purchased 3D models.

In the article, I describe the development process, the tools I used, and how I approached implementing the game mechanics with AI assistance. I also explain why I chose to use AI for certain tasks, where it worked surprisingly well, and where it fell short.

**Play the game:** [https://computerspielereien.de/fluchtpunkt/start-game.html](https://computerspielereien.de/fluchtpunkt/start-game.html)

**Read the development article:** [https://beltoforion.de/de/fluchtpunkt/index.php](https://beltoforion.de/de/fluchtpunkt/index.php)
